meta.name: test-error-states
meta.description: Force the states a happy-path run never reaches (a failing API, an empty list, a slow request, a timeout, an expired session, a toast that auto-dismisses) and check the UI actually handles them. Use when error handling was written but never run, when a loading or empty state needs verifying, when a bug only happens on a slow connection, or when a timer, poll, debounce or retry needs testing without sleeping.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 强制触发失败接口、空列表、超时等异常状态,验证界面是否真的兜住
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果错误处理代码已经写好,却从没在真实异常下跑过。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if error handling is written but never actually exercised under real failures.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能强制制造正常流程走不到的状态——失败 API、空列表、慢请求、超时,再驱动流程检查 UI 是否真的处理。它还能冻结并推进时钟,不用 sleep 就验证定时器、轮询、防抖、重试。
howto.when: 当错误处理写了却没跑过、要验证加载或空状态,或要测定时器、轮询、防抖等时触发。

say.text: 把 /api/deploys 强制返回 500,然后走一遍流程看错误提示
say.note: 会先声明期望的恢复表现再断言

say.text: 冻结时钟并推进 5 秒,验证 toast 自动消失
模拟返回空列表 200,确认页面出现空状态
say.note: 断言用户能看到具体元素

howto.what_en: Claude can force states a happy-path run never reaches — a failing API, an empty list, a slow request, a timeout — then drive the flow and check the UI handles them. It can freeze and advance the clock to test timers without sleeping.
howto.when_en: Use when error handling was written but never run, when a loading or empty state needs verifying, or when a timer, poll, debounce or retry needs testing without sleeping.

say_en.text: Mock /api/deploys as 500, then run the flow and check for an error banner.
say_en.note: Names the expected recovery before acting.

say_en.text: Freeze the clock and advance 5s to check the toast auto-dismisses.
Mock an empty 200 list and confirm the empty state shows.
say_en.note: Asserts a specific element is visible.
